prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE exceptionally polished animation direction board, landscape 3:2 high resolution, for 8x Social's final footer. Reference image is the CURRENT APPROVED endpoint and layout. Preserve its warm stone #e9e5dc surface, charcoal #171922 dots, large left asymmetric horizontal serif-8 infinity with two unequal tapered apertures, and stationary right product list. This is NOT another entrance storyboard. Show continuous LIVE MOTION AFTER the dots already form the infinity.

Title outside the website mockup: "A living infinity." Small subtitle: "Dots circulate. The surface breathes."
Upper 58%: beautifully finished wide footer preview. Large dotted infinity left, right quiet "Explore 8x" and five rows with original serif 8x prefix: "8x Careers", "8x Sale", "8x Social", "8x Research", "8x Next" and tiny "Placeholder" on Next. Bottom subtle original "8x social" left and "Build your network." right with small orange arrow. No header necessary in this crop.

Art direction for the moving infinity: maintain the original reference's broad calligraphic silhouette and negative spaces, made entirely of hundreds of distinct round carbon dots. Dots now follow disciplined curved contour lanes around its two loops instead of being a static square grid. They continuously circulate through the crossover as a single endless figure-eight current. A shallow travelling crest lifts one small region of the dot surface while another recedes. Three very closely spaced depth layers: crisp dark foreground dots, softer graphite midlayer, very faint stone-grey rear layer; no detached duplicate infinity outlines. Depth is subtle, within a few pixels, like a finely printed halftone breathing into relief, not a bulky object. Barely perceptible expansion/contraction of each loop. A soft tonal density wave travels along the dots; don't insert solid ribbons. Keep original overall proportions and profile. Minimal high-end editorial brand identity with remarkable microdetail and convincing restrained depth. Tiny soft shadows locally under lifted dots, not a large floor shadow. No chrome, gold, metallic spheres, candles or tubes.

Lower 42%: FOUR large readable equal storyboard panels on the same stone canvas, no card borders, clearly different phases, same mark scale and framing. Panel labels exactly:
"01 / 0.0s" with caption "Left loop lifts"
"02 / 2.0s" with caption "Current crosses"
"03 / 4.0s" with caption "Right loop lifts"
"04 / 6.0s" with caption "Seamless return"
Each panel must clearly show the TRAVELLING depth crest at a different position, via dot scale/density/contrast changes, keeping the entire infinity recognizable and composed. Frame 1 darker nearer left arc, frame 2 crest passing the middle crossing with clear near/far layering, frame 3 darker nearer right arc, frame 4 returns visually to frame 1. Very small fine curved direction arrows in graphite INSIDE the empty holes ONLY in the bottom instructional panels, so actual motion direction is unambiguous; never draw lines over the hero mark. One restrained small annotation beneath panels: "Continuous 6-second loop · subtle depth · stationary products". These are board annotations, not live page UI.
Constraints: No detached particle cloud, no explosion, no new colors or gradient page surfaces, no new icons, no glowing tracks, no full-page transitions, no repeated upright logo turn. All four frames already consist of dots. Give the mark plentiful breathing room. Flat frontal website composition, beautifully typeset Inter-style text, perfectly disciplined alignment, product list and footer consistent with reference. The user explicitly wants the DOTS TO MOVE, so make circulation and localized changing depth visually legible, not four identical stills.
